variants.label: 04 월왕의 장궁
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1: the sole edit target, an approved Blue Moon longbow concept (04 월왕의 장궁). Make ONE localized design correction: redirect the oversized UPPER LEFT projecting blue horn so it sweeps BACKWARD toward the bowstring side like an elegant longbow upper limb.
Orientation: in this image the bowstring / archer side is on the RIGHT. The objectionable forward horn currently extends from the upper shoulder near (580,340) far LEFT toward (280,20). Remove that forward/left jutting silhouette, and reshape that same upper horn as a smooth tall upper bow curve whose pointed END sweeps UP and to the RIGHT toward the string side, near x=700, at the top of the image. It should follow the elegant back-curved flow of a bow rather than projecting left like an antler or staff crown. The uppermost tip must visibly point right/back, never left. Maintain an open gap to the string. Integrate with the original upper bow arm, no extra branches, no added horns. Keep a graceful elongated upper limb and equivalent ornate blue crystal/gold material detailing.
Strict invariants: Only redesign that upper horn/upper silhouette in the top third (roughly y=0..430 of the 1024x1536 original). Preserve the rest of this exact image: all geometry and ornament below that area, the hanging blue crescent, hand grip, entire lower bow limb, blue crystal colors, gold/silver relief, gemstones, string, dark background, lighting, full portrait framing and scale. Do not simplify the weapon, redesign its body, mirror the image, recolor it, shift its grip, change the lower tip, or add text. Preserve the original painting as closely as possible outside the localized upper-horn change. Output one edited full bow portrait at the same 1024x1536 composition.
